text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold winning positions, but taking profits alone did not prevent my account from losing value; I should set a portfolio-level risk and allocation plan.","Selling Stock C at a large loss was painful, but avoiding that pain earlier may have prolonged a poor investment; I should reassess each holding using current evidence, not my cost or pride.","I should avoid reacting to every price move with frequent trades; before buying or selling, I will define the reason, intended position size, and conditions for changing my mind."]}
